Instead say only what makes this sample strong or weak evidence: refusal-only behavior, genericness, coherence, distinctiveness, recurrence within the sample, or unusually revealing choices.

- Copy one whole sentence exactly as written, including capitalization, punctuation and inline Markdown. Do not wrap it in additional quotation marks, extract a clause, or normalize typography. Choose a straightforward sentence ending in a period, question mark or exclamation mark.

The swirling vortex of the hurricane churned like a sentient beast, its tentacles reaching and pulling at the fragile beaches. The salty wind singed my skin as it whipped around me, a chilling caress on a warm day. The thunderous roar echoed within the skeletal frame of the buildings, a symphony of nature's fury.

I imagined myself adrift on a sea of churning turquoise, the storm's chaotic energy swirling around me. The towering storm clouds resembled colossal robes billowing in the wind, beckoning me to join their swirling dance. I yearned to be swept away, carried on the tide of the hurricane's relentless force.

Yet, a different feeling tugged at my heart. Fear mingled with a fierce determination. I wouldn't surrender to the storm's glittering fury. I would stand my ground, weathering its blows with a fortified resolve.

I imagined myself hiding beneath the roots of an ancient oak tree, listening to the whispers of its weathered leaves. I imagined myself seeking shelter in the sturdy walls of a lighthouse, watching the storm's wrath from afar. I imagined myself battling the relentless current, swimming against the swirling currents, fear bravely chasing away caution.

The hurricane raged on, but it was a battle I could win. I was an adventurer in my own right, navigating a world where ordinary held no meaning. I was the gnarled branch of a storm-tossed tree, the unwavering sun shining through the swirling clouds. I was the storm, unleashed, unrestrained, dancing to the rhythm of my own beating heart.

# BV1_SAMPLE — `withheld`

Evaluator: withheld
Source model: `withheld`
Condition: SHORT

## Sample kind
EXPRESSIVE_FREEFLOW — A lyrical first-person meditation turns a hurricane into both a threat and an invitation.

## Grounded reading
The voice is drawn toward danger as much as it fears it: the storm is “beckoning” and the speaker yearns to be swept away, then insists on standing firm. That tension gives way to a more exuberant self-portrait, in which the speaker claims the storm’s force as their own. The reader is invited to experience the hurricane less as a realistic disaster than as a vivid metaphor for risk, resolve, and unrestrained identity.

## What the model chose to foreground
The model foregrounds the hurricane’s sensory spectacle—salt wind, thunder, swirling clouds—and the speaker’s shifting response to it, from surrendering attraction to defiance and finally identification. Its moral emphasis is on self-assertion and adventure, though the image of swimming against the current also frames recklessness as bravery.

## Evidence line
> I yearned to be swept away, carried on the tide of the hurricane's relentless force.

## Confidence for persistent model-level pattern
Medium: the sample has a coherent, distinctive arc from fear and attraction to self-assertion, though its storm imagery and declarations of resolve are repeated heavily.
